counterexamples.counterexample: Structured logs can record that 10 duplicate emails were sent without preventing them. FLY-UX-007 prevents duplicates; FLY-OPS-003 merely logs them.
counterexamples.action: Reclassify edge as SUPPORTING audit trail rather than REQUIRED causal blocker for duplicate prevention.

counterexamples.counterexample: If WCAG accessibility passes 100%, an ungrounded Deal Score could still claim 99% certainty on a 1-flight sample. Accessibility does not constrain evidence certainty.
counterexamples.action: Reclassify edge as INVALID under OUTCOME-N; Accessibility requires dedicated outcome or explicit UX accessibility outcome mapping.

counterexamples.counterexample: If SQL migrations apply cleanly from 0001 to 0038, the application could still display inflated deal confidence if confidence capping logic is flawed. Migrations do not constrain claim certainty.
counterexamples.action: Reclassify edge as INVALID under OUTCOME-N; Migrations belong under Operational Parity (Outcome-L/N ops).
